name: IKHCO | TruffleUpaGas | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
White Unicorn x GushMints

Indulge in the rich, decadent flavors of Truffleupagas with this 1g live rosin puck. Hand-extracted and 100% solventless, it captures the full essence of the strain - earthy, chocolatey, and subtly nutty notes that unfold with every dab.

Silky smooth and potent, Truffleupagas delivers a balanced, euphoric lift while highlighting the pure, nuanced flavor profile of the flower. Perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate clean, flavorful, high-quality live rosin in its truest form.
